svg.aria-label: The exploration frontier over 46 subject buckets
svg.text: The corpus, and how much of it was read
46 subject buckets of the Horizon corpus. Bar length is the bucket, on a square-root scale;
the bright part is the text an agent actually fetched.
mined - bank questions drawn from it
read - an agent fetched these projects' text
35,389 projects counted by SQL → 1,613 project texts read → 116 verified topic candidates → 58 bank questions
Read means an agent fetched that project's text. Every count is SQL over the full corpus, and buckets overlap slightly.
